Last updated: November 2026

• 1. Acceptance
By creating an account or using Cunaco, you accept these Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the app.

• 2. What Cunaco is
Cunaco is an app for mothers, fathers and caregivers that helps you follow a pregnancy and track a baby's growth and health (for example, checkups, measurements and reminders).

• 3. Not a substitute for medical care
The information and tools in Cunaco are for support and organization only. They do not constitute a diagnosis, treatment or medical advice. If you have any questions or an emergency regarding your health or your baby's health, consult a healthcare professional.

• 4. Your account
You are responsible for the accuracy of the data you enter and for keeping your account confidential. Cunaco is intended for adults; it is not meant for minors to create an account.

• 5. Acceptable use
You agree not to use the app for illegal purposes, not to attempt to access other people's data, not to alter or interfere with the operation of the service, and not to copy or redistribute the app without authorization.

• 6. Intellectual property
The app, its design, brand, characters and content belong to its creators. You are granted a personal, limited and revocable license to use it. The data you enter remains yours.

• 7. Availability and changes
We try to keep the service running continuously, but we do not guarantee that it will be free of errors or interruptions. We may modify, suspend or discontinue features at any time.

• 8. Limitation of liability
To the extent permitted by law, Cunaco is not responsible for decisions made based on the information in the app, or for indirect damages arising from its use.

• 9. Account deletion
You can request the deletion of your account and all your data at any time through the corresponding option inside the app or by writing to cunacoapp@gmail.com.

• 10. Changes to these terms
We may update these terms. If the changes are significant, we will let you know in the app and may ask you to accept them again.

• 11. Contact
For questions about these terms, write to us at cunacoapp@gmail.com.

Last updated: November 2026

At Cunaco we care about your privacy and your baby's privacy. This policy explains what data we process, why, and what control you have over it.

• 1. Data we collect. Account data: email address and, if you sign in with Google, your name and profile photo.
• Data you enter: information about your pregnancy and your baby, such as date of birth, growth measurements, checkups and other health and development records.
• Basic technical data needed for the app to work and stay stable (for example, error reports), if enabled.

• 2. How we use your data
We use your data only to provide you with the app's features: signing in, saving your records, showing you your information, and keeping the service running and secure.

• 3. We do not sell or share your personal data
We do not sell, rent or distribute your personal data or your baby's data to third parties, and we do not use it for advertising. It could only be disclosed if a competent authority requires it under the law.

• 4. Service providers
To operate the app we use Google Firebase services (such as authentication and a cloud database) that store and process data on our behalf and solely to provide the service.

• 5. Security
We apply reasonable technical measures to protect your information, such as encrypted connections and access control. No system is completely infallible, so we recommend using a strong password.

• 6. Retention and deletion
We keep your data while your account is active. You can request the deletion of your account and all your data at any time through the corresponding option in the app or by writing to cunacoapp@gmail.com. Once the request is processed, your data is permanently deleted.

• 7. Your rights
You can access, correct or delete your data, and withdraw your consent at any time. To exercise these rights, use the options in the app or write to us.

• 8. Minors
Cunaco is intended for adult mothers, fathers and caregivers. The baby's data is entered and managed by their mother, father or legal guardian, who declares that they have the authority to do so.

• 9. Changes to this policy
We may update this policy. If the changes are significant, we will let you know in the app.

• 10. Contact
If you have questions about your privacy, write to us at cunacoapp@gmail.com.
